About

A business built through decades of developing award-winning digital and physical consumer products.

Founded on Creativity

Charlie and Sally in front of Creativity’s “Toy Wall”
Creativity was founded in 1998 by Charlie and Sally Albert. Charlie brought a unique blend of experience in music, technology, and product development, while Sally's expertise in human resources and business operations established the foundation for the company's growth. Together, they built a company dedicated to helping inventors and manufacturers transform ideas into successful products.
What began as a small development studio grew into a multidisciplinary team specializing in play design, engineering, software, content creation, audio, animatronics, and interactive experiences.

A Legacy of Innovation

Since 1998, Creativity has contributed to more than 7,000 products and helped create some of the toy industry's most recognized and successful brands. Our work has been honored with more than 130 Toy of the Year nominations and 35+ Toy of the Year awards.
From traditional toys and games to connected products, apps, voice experiences, and emerging technologies, Creativity has spent more than 25 years helping clients bring ideas to life.
